snippet.title: Rodent Rampage Trailer
snippet.description:
When it comes to acorn selection, it’s do or starve, and S.Q. Tailblazer sure ain’t gonna starve! This year you have a plan… As seen on tv, everything's better with a jetpack. Lucky for you, not everyone remembers to lock their shed – and there’s a leaf blower inside with your name on it. Good thing you stole that engineering degree!

Free to download and play on iOS and Android.

--- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6450372936
--- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MassDiGI.TeamCaramelApple

MassDigi SIP23 - Rodent Rampage game
